limitations: All introduced defects are synthetic. No physical failure, hardware safety, functional timing, native-clean control or model quality is claimed.
Nine value cases freeze source nominal assembly values as benchmark requirements, not measured electrical failure thresholds.
Fourteen wire swap/removal cases alter schematic conductors only; PCB copper remains intentionally unchanged. Parity-rich results are not manufactured wiring defect detection.

Five wrong-footprint cases transplant real 1.27mm library pad geometry into the source footprint at preserved pad1/placement, retaining original graphics. They test mating geometry, not a renamed property or a complete replacement courtyard/model.

Two population cases remove RFID protection; fuse bypass merges its copper nets and bridges former pads; shunt deletion preserves USB data paths. Schematic and native saved-copper connectivity partitions are checked structurally before registration.

External custom symbol/footprint libraries and 3D models are inventoried but complete dependency/license closure is unqualified. Native tools must report missing dependencies; no substitute libraries/parts are synthesized.

Controls are unassessed prior to this preregistration. Existing genuine issues and unresolved findings are not automatically false alarms. No independently adjudicated negative opportunities or false-alarm rate yet.
DRC predictions require new native records in the declared section at exact target UUIDs relative to the paired control. Unrelated findings do not count.

Hardware-interface predictions require an exact registered invariant violation with the paired control invariant satisfied. Unsupported, execution errors and control-unresolved cases remain in the all-30 denominator.

Third-party sources and all generated candidates/results remain scratch-only. Redistribution eligibility is recorded from upstream license metadata; publication and complete dependency closure still require owner review/approval.
Deterministic checks-only review cannot complete independent initial review/adjudication; its overall incomplete status is not itself a seeded detection or a check failure. Model passes are excluded.
Owner review is outstanding and separate from peer review.
